name: arquibancada
description: Placar ao vivo dos jogos universitários (TUSCA, InterUSP e afins): público, mesários e painel admin.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:push -w api && npm run seed -w api
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:sandbox: concurrently -k -n api,web -c yellow,magenta "npm run dev:sandbox -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w api
scripts.test: npm test -w api && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
